brief: A sleek, authoritative developer identity adhering strictly to the Vercel Geist design system (#171717 ink on #fafafa canvas, #ebebeb hairlines, and Geist typography). Replacing generic placeholder icons with an ownable, mathematically precise letterform that thrives across micro-scales (16px favicon) and macro-displays.

concepts.name: The Terminal Apex
concepts.idea: An architectural equilateral 'A' embedding an upward terminal chevron and negative-space deployment vector.
rationale: Evolves the Vercel delta geometry into a bespoke, proprietary letterform ('A' for Ali) without breaking the established Geist design harmony.
Precision-engineered with exact 60°/120° angles, scoring 100/100 on production SVG audit tests.
Includes a dedicated optical small-size cut with widened counters that maintains perfect clarity at 16px and 24px.

recommendation: Concept A (The Terminal Apex) establishes a definitive, recognizable developer signature that bridges full-stack engineering and agentic AI systems.
